response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items GROUP BY order_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS average_quantity FROM Order_Items) SELECT p.order_id, p.average_quantity, p.average_quantity - b.average_quantity AS difference_from_baseline FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.average_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.average_quantity IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, difference_from_baseline DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Non-NULL product_quantity values contain numeric text that can be cast to DECIMAL(19,4).
